description: Defines the Address value object class used in the OrderAggregate within the ApplicationCore.Entities namespace, encapsulating address details with properties and constructors.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: A value object representing a physical address, with properties for street, city, state, country, and zip code. Includes a private parameterless constructor for Entity Framework and a public constructor for initialization.

methods.name: Address
methods.description: Constructor that initializes all address properties with provided values.
